vuln_type: Unvalidated external call through misconfigured router
adjudication_basis: Both reports identify the same mistaken USDC router admission enabling arbitrary transferFrom calls. The linked PoC header names the exploit execution; the funds-to-mixer reference is not substituted for it.

independent_observations.vulnerability_class: Unvalidated external call through misconfigured router
independent_observations.mechanism_excerpt: The attacker abused that USDC had been added as a router (by the admin), leading to an arbitrary function call with USDC contract.
